title: Temporal sequence operator: `then ... within`
preamble:
# Temporal sequence operator: `then ... within`

A binary pattern combinator
`X then Y within T` that compiles to the standard
"strictly after X, within T" timestamp constraint,
plus an optional `latest` prefix for the common
"after the most-recent X" case. This doc specifies
the semantics; the author-facing grammar is
[LGRA].

Paired with:

- [LGRA] —
  the author-facing grammar.
- [LLOG] — context
  for how timestamps on facts participate in LHS
  matching.
